title: December 2024 Beneficial Ownership Reporting Perimeter
question: What happened to the federal beneficial-ownership reporting obligation after the December 3, 2024 Texas Top Cop Shop injunction, and what operative perimeter existed by September 25, 2026?
bluf: The December 3, 2024 nationwide injunction interrupted FinCEN's broad domestic-and-foreign BOI reporting rule but did not permanently repeal the CTA. After several judicial posture changes, Treasury suspended domestic enforcement and FinCEN used separate exemption authority to narrow the rule to qualifying foreign entities. FinCEN adopted that foreign-entity-focused perimeter as final on August 14, 2026, with additional U.S.-person exemptions.
